# Enforcement To ensure stations run effectively, Standard Operating Procedure and Company Policy will be enforced by the Justice department. They answer directly to the Chief Justice, or the Commanding Officer in their absence. In cases where the Chief Justice or Commanding Officer are being charged, Central Command should be notified.
When sentencing, the justice official should present the arrest warrant with a complete list of SOP violations, or citations, to be charged. The accused has the right to appeal these charges to the Chief Justice. If possible, the accused should be first contacted via radio, or in person. If they refuse citations, and do not comply, they may be arrested by security and charged with OOJ in addition to any criminal violations.
